title: AI Implementation Consultant
description:
Title: AI Implementation Specialist for UK Consumer Credit Firm (Hertfordshire / London, Hybrid)

About us
We are a small UK consumer credit company. Our core operations run on a bespoke PHP system, and we want to use AI to cut manual admin, speed up customer communication and give our team more time for higher-value work.

What we want to achieve
We want to introduce AI agents or bots that can learn how our PHP system works and help with day-to-day processes and communication, specifically:
- Drafting emails to customers and handling routine responses
- Sending emails automatically where appropriate, with human approval where needed
- Taking actions in our system based on incoming messages (for example, updating records or triggering the next step in a process)
- Learning from our existing templates, past correspondence and internal processes so the output matches our tone and rules

What you’ll do
- Review our PHP system and workflows and identify the best opportunities for AI
- Recommend the right approach and tools (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, automation platforms, or a mix) and explain the trade-offs in plain English
- Design and build an initial working solution, starting with a focused pilot, then expand it.
- Integrate the AI securely with our PHP system, email and any other systems it needs.
- Build in human-in-the-loop controls, audit logs and clear guardrails on what the AI can and cannot do
- Document everything and train our team to use and maintain it
